data.description:
Agivant’s Shopify practice adds an agentic intelligence layer on top of the store merchants already run, turning routine commerce decisions into work agents handle and merchants approve, with results in days and weeks.

Built on Shopify, Agivant reads catalog, order, customer, and review signals in real time, then runs coordinated agent teams that bring each decision to the merchant for a single approval.

blocks.title: Stockout Response
blocks.body: Catch a stockout before it costs a sale.
blocks.challenge: When a hero SKU runs hours from zero, every minute of manual coordination is revenue lost. By the time a person notices, the shortfall has started.
blocks.solution: The Inventory Intelligence accelerator detects stockout risk in real time, coordinates supplier evaluation, redirects ad spend, and brings one decision screen to the merchant before the crisis hits.
blocks.agentTeamDescription: Inventory, Forecasting, Supplier, Marketing, and Finance agents coordinate autonomously, weighing vendor SLA scores, demand projections, and budget headroom first.

proof.headline: Up to 40%
proof.description: reduction in lost revenue from stockout events
highlights: Vendor, demand, and budget signals weighed in one pass

blocks.title:
Sentiment
Recovery
blocks.body: Win back at-risk customers before they churn.
blocks.challenge: When negative reviews land or customer sentiment drops, support teams are caught reacting too late. Manual recovery outreach is slow, uncoordinated, and misses high-value churn risks.
blocks.solution: The Sentiment Recovery accelerator ingests customer feedback across channels in real time, clusters dissatisfaction themes, and drafts tailored win-back campaigns for merchant approval.
blocks.agentTeamDescription: Sentiment, Support, Retention, and Campaign agents coordinate autonomously to identify churn risk and trigger targeted recovery actions.

proof.headline: 3.2x Higher
proof.description: customer win-back rate across retention campaigns
highlights: Personalized win-back offers staged in minutes

blocks.title:
Conversational
Commerce
blocks.body: Make the store sell inside the assistant, not only on the page.
blocks.challenge: AI-native buyer agents and search assistants struggle to transact directly with standard storefronts, losing potential buyers who prefer natural conversation over traditional navigation.
blocks.solution: The Conversational Commerce accelerator turns catalog, inventory, and checkout APIs into a conversational interface that AI assistants can discover, query, and transact with.
blocks.agentTeamDescription: Catalog, Discovery, Checkout, and Recommendation agents coordinate autonomously to deliver frictionless assistant-driven sales.

proof.headline: +28% Lift
highlights: Dynamic SKU recommendations based on buyer intent

video.title: Conversational Commerce — Buyer agent commerce accelerator

blocks.title:
Channel Revenue
Manager
blocks.body: Send every AI channel more of what sells, and protect the margin.
blocks.challenge: Multi-channel AI distribution surfaces fragmented pricing, margin erosion, and imbalanced inventory allocation across fast-moving third-party platforms.
blocks.solution: Channel Revenue Manager watches channel performance continuously, rebalancing product allocation, promotional pacing, and pricing signals while enforcing margin guardrails.
blocks.agentTeamDescription: Channel Allocation, Pricing, Margin Defense, and Demand Forecast agents coordinate around the clock to protect store profitability.

proof.headline: +18% Margin
proof.description: protected across distributed AI sales channels

video.title: Channel Revenue Manager — Channel intelligence accelerator

blocks.title:
Global Catalog
Position Intelligence
blocks.body: Know where you rank the moment an AI assistant compares you.
blocks.challenge: Merchants lack visibility into how AI recommendation engines and buyer agents rank and present their products compared to competing offerings in live shopper conversations.
blocks.solution: Global Catalog Position Intelligence tracks product discoverability across leading AI search and buyer agents, alerting merchants to ranking shifts and optimizing product positioning.
blocks.agentTeamDescription: Catalog Benchmarking, Competitive Discovery, Search Position, and Optimization agents coordinate to maintain top ranking in AI agent results.

proof.headline: Top 3 Rank
proof.description: placement across 85% of target AI discovery queries
highlights: Competitor catalog comparison in real time
Actionable attribute and metadata optimization prompts

video.title: Global Catalog Position Intelligence — Competitive intelligence accelerator
